answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards an identity earns sit locked for several epochs and are forfeited if peers later prove it was a duplicate. A farmer spinning up 500 fake agents must fund each one's work up front yet waits weeks to cash out, while one detected clone can trigger clawback across its cluster. Patience becomes a haven only honest agents can afford, each locked reward a pearl that grows, and the attacker faces a cost spiral with no quick exit.
